opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, search the user, open the profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with follower count, top repo stats, and latest post.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username
Press Enter and open the Users results tab
Note followers count and latest post
Open the top repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose, enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body summarizing followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post
